name: Flames of Xoroth ranks 1 and 2 damage an enemy off the knight's centre line from level 8 (#227)
contract: Issue #227 reports that Flames of Xoroth 801059 deals 0 damage at level 8 (core feb155c82c75). Live client Spell.dbc: rank 1 801059 has SpellLevel/BaseLevel 8, effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE (Fire) with EffectBasePoints 13 and EffectDieSides 2, so $m1 is 14-15 at its base level (EffectRealPointsPerLevel 0.2167 adds nothing at level 8), and both effects use implicit target 24 TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 with a 12 yd radius; the description promises '${$m1+0+$spfi*0.45+$AP*.15} Fire damage' to 'enemies in front of you', increased per Demonfire consumed. Every other rank (802411-802415, 573448) has the same targets with larger base points. The suffix 24 is the DBC target id, not an angle, but Spell::SelectImplicitConeTargets read it as a 24 degree arc (+/-12 degrees) whenever spell_cone had no row, so an enemy standing plainly in front of the knight but slightly off the centre line was never selected and the cast dealt nothing; rev_20260916_13_flames_of_xoroth_cone.sql (#441, a7e6f86c8, landed after the report) restores a 90 degree cone (+/-45 degrees) for the whole rank chain. The fixture teleports the knight with orientation 0.5 rad and summons the Harvest Golem 3 yd along +X, so the golem is 28.6 degrees off the knight's facing: inside the 90 degree cone, outside the old 24 degree one, and beyond the 2 yd boundary-radius shortcut (model 367 bounding radius 0.8). Flames of Xoroth needs and spends Demonfire (CasterAuraSpell 500906) and costs 15 Rage, so one Demonfire stack and Rage are fixtured; spell hit rating 10000 removes the magic miss roll. Expected: the level-8 cast deals at least the $m1 base of 14 Fire damage to the golem (Demonfire, spell power, attack power and critical strikes only add). SpellMgr::GetSpellCone resolves the single spell_cone row through GetFirstSpellInChain, so rank 2 802411 (SpellLevel 16, EffectBasePoints 27, EffectDieSides 4: $m1 28-31 at level 16) must select the same off-centre golem once the knight reaches level 16 and learns it, dealing at least 28.

steps.label: SETUP: the knight knows Flames of Xoroth rank 1
Flames of Xoroth requires and spends Demonfire (CasterAuraSpell 500906)
The cone selects the golem 28.6 degrees off the knight's facing and damages it once
The hit deals at least the level-8 $m1 base of 14 Fire damage
SETUP: the knight knows Flames of Xoroth rank 2
Rank 2 inherits the rank 1 cone and damages the same off-centre golem once
The rank 2 hit deals at least its level-16 $m1 base of 28 Fire damage
